# Phase Two — Critique

The Awtsmoos gives restraint so green tests do not become a false goal;
Awtsmoos.com needs contracts for user-visible truth, not frozen implementation control.

Improvements:
- Read the real owner module for each invariant.
- Assert disclosure insertion and current grid architecture explicitly.
- Assert old four-column architecture is not required.
- Do not weaken mobile/context assertions that already protect the redesign.
- Do not alter production code to satisfy stale test ownership.
- Run browser verification after tests because source contracts cannot prove visual geometry.
- Measure performance after browser correctness, then use those results to rank sitewide work.
